note: The standard sizes of the doors and the windows of World: nominal sizes (the size of the door or of the window unit, not of its rough opening).

door_us.source: Door & More, standard door sizes: interior doors 24, 28, 30, 32 and 36 in wide, 80 in high, a slab of 1 3/8 in; exterior doors 36 by 80 in, a slab of 1 3/4 in. The rough opening of a prehung door: 2 in wider and 2 1/2 in higher (Home Depot, Prehung Unit Installation). An egress door: at least 32 in clear and 78 in high (IRC R311.2, AIBD).

garage.source: Clopay, the average garage door size: 8 by 7 and 9 by 7 ft for one car, 16 by 7 ft for two; OGD: 9 by 8 and 16 by 8 ft, the doors of 8 ft high (width by height, in).

window_us.source: A single-hung window by its code: the width and the height in feet and inches (3040 is 3 ft 0 in by 4 ft 0 in: PRL Glass, standard window sizes); the rough openings of Viwinco (2026 size charts, page 1) are 20 to 52 in wide in steps of 4 and 36 to 80 in high. An escape window (IRC R310, 2021: Boulder County B10): at least 5.7 sq ft open, 20 in wide, 24 in high, the sill at most 44 in over the floor.

door_vn.source: TCVN 4451:2012 Nhà ở, Bảng 4: a door of a way out is at least 0.8 m wide (clear) and 2.0 m high; QCVN 06:2022/BXD: an exit at least 0.8 m wide and 1.9 m high (clear). The sizes of the market for a door of a room: 900 by 2200 mm with an opening of 810 by 2155 mm, and of a toilet 780 by 2015 mm (giahuydoor.vn; estimates of the market, not a standard).
